title: Additional security demand under clause 4.20 — writ dismissed
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Krishna Murari and Ashwani Kumar Mishra, JJ. (3.7.2014); Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J. (21.3.2017)
disposition: Writ dismissed following connected matter; additional-security challenge fails.
headnote: A writ by an industrial consumer seeking to quash a demand notice for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed, the Court directing that the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016 be seen. An earlier Division Bench had, on 3 July 2014, connected the petition with similar matters and restrained the licensee from demanding additional security until further orders.
facts: The petitioner, M/s Shri Rathi Steel Limited, an industrial consumer, challenged a demand notice issued by Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. for additional security, said to have been raised under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel relied on an interim order of 7 October 2009 in a similar writ (M/s Supreme Ceramics Limited v. PVVNL) and submitted that identical questions were pending in several matters. The petition was connected with Writ Petition (C) No. 51884 of 2009.

holding_units.holding: The writ seeking quashing of a demand notice for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed, the Court directing that the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016 be seen. An earlier interim restraint on demanding additional security, granted by reference to similar pending writs, did not survive the final dismissal.

not_decided.note: This order dismisses the writ by reference to the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016 and does not itself interpret the additional-security clause.
